## Type · 类型

- [ ] `feat` — new capability · 新功能
- [ ] `fix` — bug fix · 问题修复
- [ ] `refactor` — no behaviour change · 重构，行为不变
- [ ] `perf` — performance · 性能
- [ ] `test` — tests only · 仅测试
- [ ] `docs` — documentation only · 仅文档
- [ ] `chore` — tooling, deps, config · 工具 / 依赖 / 配置

## How it was verified · 如何验证

<!-- Which platforms did you actually run this on? Which cases did you try? · 实际在哪些平台上跑过？覆盖了哪些场景？ -->

- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] Ran on iOS · 在 iOS 上运行过
- [ ] Ran on Android · 在 Android 上运行过
- [ ] Ran on web · 在网页端运行过

## Screenshots · 截图

<!-- Required for anything visual — before/after if you can. · 涉及界面的改动必填，最好有前后对比。 -->

## Checklist · 自检清单

- [ ] The diff covers one concern · 这个 PR 只做一件事
- [ ] New user-visible strings are in **both** `src/i18n/zh/` and `src/i18n/en/` · 新增文案已同时写入中英文语言包
- [ ] A bug fix comes with a test that failed before it · bug 修复附带了「修复前会失败」的测试
- [ ] Docs updated if behaviour changed · 行为变化时已更新文档
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated for user-visible changes · 面向用户的改动已记入 CHANGELOG
- [ ] No secrets, API keys or real personal data in the diff · 改动中不含密钥或真实个人数据
